definition_zh: 化验；分析；试验；试图；化验样品
definition_en: to test or analyze a substance, or an attempt or trial of something
core_image: 炼金炉边舀出一点合金检验成色的匠人
scene: 珠宝匠用小勺舀出微量金属，在坩埚中检验金子的成色。The jeweler assayed the ring to confirm it was pure gold.
sceneCN: 这里 assay 是「化验、检验」（第 1 个义项：分析测定成分）；句意是珠宝匠检验戒指以确认其为纯金。

derivatives.zh: 同根词（法语 essai），义为「散文；尝试」
由动词加施动后缀构成，义为「化验员」
由动词加后缀构成，义为「可化验的」

senses.title: To test a substance
senses.definition: to analyze a metal, drug, or other substance to determine its components or purity
senses.definitionCN: 分析金属、药物等物质以确定成分或纯度
senses.example: The mint assayed every batch of coins for purity.
senses.exampleCN: 造币厂对每一批硬币做纯度化验。
senses.why: Latin exagium meant a weighing; testing a metal began with weighing it against a standard.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 exagium 意为称量；检验金属始于与标准比对称重。

senses.title: To attempt or undertake
senses.definition: to try or attempt something difficult
senses.example: She assayed a dangerous climb in her youth.
senses.exampleCN: 她年轻时曾尝试一次危险的攀登。
senses.why: A weighing is a trial of value, so the verb grew a general sense of putting something to the test.
senses.whyCN: 称量即价值的试验，动词因此生出「加以考验」的泛义。

senses.title: A trial or test as a noun
senses.definition: a test, analysis, or the report of one
senses.definitionCN: 一次检验、分析或其报告
senses.example: The lab returned an assay of the water supply.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室提交了水质的化验报告。
senses.why: The noun keeps the result of the weighing: a measured judgment.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了称量的结果：一次量化的判断。

intro.en: Assay comes from Old French essai, from Late Latin exagium, a weighing, from ex- plus agere, to drive or weigh out.
intro.cn: assay 源自古法语 essai，来自后期拉丁语 exagium（称量），由 ex- 加 agere（称出）构成。

items.en: Exagium meant the act of weighing or a balance scale.
items.cn: 拉丁语 exagium 指称量行为或天平。
后期拉丁语 exagiare 意为称出。

items.en: Essai meant a trial or test; essay came from the same word.
items.cn: 古法语 essai 意为试验；essay 同源于此。

items.en: English took both assay and essay from the French word.
items.cn: 中古英语同时借入 assay 与 essay。

items.en: Assay specialized in technical testing; essay kept the literary sense.
items.cn: assay 专用于技术检验，essay 保留文学义。

note.en: Assay and essay are twins: both from essai, but assay stayed scientific while essay turned literary.
note.cn: assay 与 essay 是孪生词：同出 essai，前者走向科学检验，后者走向文学文章。

entries.definition: a short written composition; originally a trial
one who assays metals or drugs

normalIntro.en: Hear a-say: assay is asking a substance to say what it is.
normalIntro.cn: 谐音「额塞」→「额测」：额来测一测成分，就是 assay（化验）。

normal.en: essay and assay share the root essai.
normal.cn: essay 与 assay 同出词根 essai。

normal.en: exagium is a weighing on scales.

normal.cn: 造币化验确认硬币纯度。

normal.en: assay a task: put it on the scales.
normal.cn: assay a task：把任务放上秤盘，即尝试。

normal.en: an assay returns numbers, not opinions.
normal.cn: 化验给出的是数字，而非意见。

abstract.en: Picture scales trembling until they balance.
abstract.cn: 想象天平颤动直至平衡。

abstract.en: Feel one spoonful standing for a whole mine.
abstract.cn: 感受一勺样品代表整座矿山。

abstract.en: See a first draft called an essay because it dares.
abstract.cn: 看见因敢于尝试而被称为 essay 的初稿。

examples.en: Chemists assayed the tablets for hidden steroids.
examples.cn: 化学家化验药片中是否含违禁类固醇。

examples.en: He assayed the role of Hamlet while still a student.
examples.cn: 他还在求学时便尝试出演哈姆雷特。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额塞」——额把样品塞进坩埚测一测，正是 assay 的化验。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（出）+ agere（驱动、称量）→ exagium「称量」→ 古法语 essai「试验」，英语分化出 assay 与 essay。

sensesIntro.en: Weighing becomes testing metals, then attempting any hard task, then the test itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 称量化为检验金属，再化为尝试难事，最后指检验本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single spoonful weighed against the standard
core.cn: 核心意象：一勺样品与标准比对称量

intro.en: The exagium family gave English both its laboratory verb and its literary noun.
intro.cn: exagium 词族为英语贡献了实验室动词与文学名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere, to drive or do, is one of Latin's most fruitful roots.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere（驱动、做）是拉丁语最多产的词根之一。

items.meaning: a trial, hence a written composition
a substance used in chemical analysis
